sensitivityNotes.T2: commercial, finance, employment, guest PII — grant needs a reason, audited

actionNotes.sign: attestation — sign an entry, acknowledge, complete a checklist

departments.label: Shore – Fleet Ops & DPA
departments.description: Designated Person Ashore, fleet management, technical

separationOfDuties.description: Whoever runs payroll cannot approve it.
Invoice approver cannot record the payment.
Expense approver cannot mark it paid.
Refit invoice approver cannot record the payment.
Whoever uploads a matrix import cannot apply it (four-eyes).
HOD approval and final approval must be different people on the same record.
Officer who signs an entry cannot countersign it.
Nobody approves their own hours of rest.
Raiser of a PO cannot give final approval.
Nobody grants access to themselves; T2/T3 grants need a reason.
Permit issuer cannot authorise their own permit.

signOffExtras.area: ISM / SMS areas (Vessel › Safety, Certificates, Logbooks)
